evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically from ~6 ppm to 51.5 ppm through growth stage
Tube pressure creeping up from 2.98 to 3.44 Torr while Ar flow held steady at 100 sccm
MFC stable at setpoint, so pressure rise is not flow-driven
Temperature control nominal at 750 °C, heater power steady ~43%

args.missing_evidence: A flow-off/pump-down pressure-rise-rate test (or Ar step change) to distinguish an air in-leak from exhaust restriction; downstream O2 sensor cross-check.
